description: Buy or sell one side of a market on paper, at the venue's live price including its fee. No money moves. A buy is sized in usd (maxPrice caps the price paid); a sell in contracts or "all" (minPrice floors it). requestId is any string chosen by the caller; a retry with the same requestId never places the order twice.

outcome.description: The side by name, e.g. "Yes" or "Lakers".

requestId.description: Any unique string; a retry with the same one returns the first order.

name: place_paper_order
title: Place a paper order
